headline: desired_capacity is set below min_size: AWS will ignore this setting and keep 3 instances running, defeating the cost savings goal

findings.evidence_ref: desired_capacity = 1 while min_size = 3 in the diff
findings.explanation: AWS requires desired_capacity to be at least min_size. The autoscaling group will maintain 3 instances regardless, and the change will have no effect. To scale down to 1 instance, min_size must also be lowered to 1.
